about: Every word the presenter adds beside the pre-registered sentences once the final run is published: the report's lede and card, its section leads, the final charts' titles, headings, descriptions and captions, the history page's names for the final run's files. A template holds no number of its own and no model id: each placeholder is filled from presentation.json, and a template declares its placeholders in its fields.

report.lede.text: > Generated by `python -m evals.present` from `evals/results` (the headline: `{source}`, the pre-registered final run). Do not edit by hand: change `evals/present/` and run `python -m evals.present --write`. The same report as a page: [{pages}]({pages}).

card.data.text: {letters} synthetic letters in the final split, {split}: {items} dated deadlines in {clusters} letter clusters

card.protocol.text: Written and audited after the code freeze by agents isolated from the code, the prompts and every result; nothing tuned on it, and every read recorded whatever the earlier reads showed ([Data and labels]({anchor}))

card.prereg.text: Pre-registered: `{file}` (hash `{hash}`), the file the final analysis names by its hash; the code frozen at commit `{freeze}` (pull request {pr})

card.reads.text: {used} of the {registered} pre-registered reads of each letter

card.intervals.text: Clopper–Pearson for a rate in one read; a bootstrap over letter clusters for a mean over the reads and for a difference; sign-flip tests over letter clusters with Holm within each family, non-inferiority by inverting the sign-flip test, and McNemar for stability ([Statistics]({anchor}))

results.final.lead.text: Every sentence the pre-registration holds about the final run, decided or not, in its registered order; the README's block says the ones its role list names, word for word. Each is filled from the final analysis and the files it names by rules fixed before any result.

history.kind.ask-final.text: Ask held-out set, its runs together

chart.final.title.text: The final run: exact date and harm, over its reads

chart.final.subtitle.text: {items} deadlines in {letters} synthetic letters · {reads} reads · {split} · {model} · {level} % CI, letter-cluster bootstrap ({method})

chart.final.footnote.text: Dots: the mean over the reads, with its interval. Hollow rings: each read alone. Harmful: the person would act too late, or never.

chart.final.description.text: Dot plot of the final run, {items} deadlines read {reads} times: each condition's mean over the reads with its {level} % interval, and each read. {rows}.

chart.final.row.text: {condition}: {exact} exactly right ({exact_ci}; reads {exact_reads}), {harm} late or missed ({harm_ci}; reads {harm_reads})

chart.final.tip.exact.text: {condition}: {value} exactly right, the mean over the reads, {level} % CI {ci}

chart.final.tip.harm.text: {condition}: {value} late or missed, the mean over the reads, {level} % CI {ci}

chart.final.caption.text: Over the reads, Ordnung dates {ordnung_exact} exactly right with {ordnung_harm} late or missed; the model alone {alone_exact} with {alone_harm}; the agent given the engine as a tool {agent_exact} with {agent_harm}.
